Yes, we understand that you are currently staying with us. We have also shared the October extension rate, which is AED 9,000 for 30 nights. Unfortunately, we are unable to offer a lower rate.

Please let us know if you would like to extend your stay.

Regarding the listings on fäm Properties, if a property is mentioned as available on a yearly basis, we kindly request you to contact the agent whose name is shown on the listing, as they will be able to assist you with the property.

Thank you for your understanding.
